_readme: Every image and video the homepage shows, in one place. `from` is a path inside the FlavorDraft app
documentation (flavordraft-app-docs/, gitignored; SCREENS_SRC points elsewhere if needed).
`crop` is [x, y, width, height] in source pixels; `bands`, in its place, cuts several full-width
strips of one screen and sets them one under the other (an excerpt, as App Store screenshot 03
does: nothing retyped or redrawn). `radius` rounds the crop into an alpha mask
(`continuous` with an `exponent` makes the corners iOS's superellipse instead of circles),
`widths` are the output widths written as AVIF and WebP into src/assets/img/screens/.
A video source takes a `frame` (decoded as a browser shows it); `base: "repo"` reads a file
this repository generates (the page-turn clip from `npm run media`) instead of the docs.
`rights` is the reuse status the documentation records for what is visible in the image:
owned            FlavorDraft's own interface or artwork only
publisher-photos the screen shows recipe photographs imported from publishers; the slab and
Duo capture READMEs say: "None of it is cleared for marketing use."
The build prints every image and video that is not `owned`, so none ships unnoticed. To replace
an image, point `from` at a re-seeded capture of the same screen and run `npm run screens`.
`media` records the rights of the video `npm run media` writes; it is not built from here.
No image here shows Apple hardware: the App Store frames' drawn and 3D-rendered devices and the
Duo Studio film (Track A) are not used on the website (see the rights review in the docs).

images._note: iPhone Duo inner display held wide: Chicken Parmesan as a cookbook spread, method on the left page, ingredients on the right, the fold between them (the Duo App Store frame 02's capture). Cropped to the two pages: the system's Vertical Bar and home indicator are left out. Shows the recipe's 44 pt video thumbnail (The Cooking Foodie) and the app's ingredient icons, whose pack licence for marketing is still to be confirmed (creative/validation/rights-inventory-r3.md).
